The dwarves hid a shiny helmet deep in their mines, guarded by giant spiders. Go down through the {wiki:Dwarf Mines} (from Kazordoon) or through the Undead Cave of {wiki:Mount Sternum} (from Thais), pass the level 35 door and take the {item:Crusader Helmet} from a skeleton at the bottom of the tunnel.
The dwarves hid a shiny helmet deep in their mines, guarded by giant spiders.
Pick 'N Shovel Mine entrance, west of Kazordoon
Level 35 for the expertise door (40+ recommended).
Any melee weapon or a {item:Firebug} to break the {item:Spider Web|spider webs}

There are two paths: the original one through the Dwarf Mines (from Kazordoon) and, since version 8.1, a faster one through Mount Sternum and the Undead Cave (from Thais). The final part is the same in both.
{creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} poison and hit hard for low levels: bring potions and something to cure poison.
Faster path. If you prefer to go via Kazordoon, skip to section 1B.
Leave **Thais** towards {wiki:Mount Sternum} and go down here.
Head **northwest**: you will meet quite a few {creature:Cyclops} and maybe some {creature:Cyclops Drone|Cyclops Drones}. Go down here.
You are in the {wiki:Mount Sternum/Undead Cave|Undead Cave}, with {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}. Walk a little **north** and go down the hole.
Go down to the Dwarf Mines
You meet {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}. Head **northeast** and go down the hole.

You have entered the Dwarf Mines: as you go down you meet 3 {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}, and further on more Dwarf Soldiers and {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}. Head **north** and then **northeast** and go down the hole. Continue in section 2.
1B. Path through the Dwarf Mines (from Kazordoon)
Original path. If you already went via Mount Sternum, skip to section 2.
Go to the {wiki:Dwarf Mines|Pick 'N Shovel Mine}, west of **Kazordoon**. Head **east** and go down the hole.
Go straight down another hole and then keep heading well **west**.
North, west and one more hole
Go **north** and **west** and go down one more hole. Continue in section 2.
You will meet {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}. Head **east**, continuing down the mine.
There are many Dwarf Guards. Go **north** and pass the level 35 expertise door.
Go down the hole. {item:Spider Web|Spider webs} block the way: break them with a melee weapon or a {item:Firebug}.
There are 4 {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} in the area. They come one at a time and, on the way to the helmet, you should only meet 3.
The {item:Crusader Helmet} is in a skeleton corpse at the far **west** end of the tunnel. Open it and take the helmet.

To leave, go back the same way you came: cross the spider tunnel again, go up with the {item:Rope} at each hole you went down and pass the level 35 door again. You come out onto the surface at {wiki:Mount Sternum} (if you came from Thais) or at the Pick 'N Shovel Mine, west of Kazordoon (if you came through the Dwarf Mines).
The {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} may have respawned on the way back.
